players.product: Bili series GPGPU chips and intelligent computing solutions (GPU servers, SuperPods and clusters) for cloud AI training and inference

quarterly_data.quarter: Biren Technology interim results announcement: Interim Results for the Six Months Ended June 30, 2026 (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 (unaudited): revenue RMB1,235.5 million, up 1,997.6% YoY; gross profit RMB527.1 million (+2,708.5%); gross margin 42.7%, up 1,080 bps, driven by revenue growth from cloud training products; R&D expenses RMB804.4 million (+40.7%); loss for the period RMB377.2 million (-76.4%); adjusted loss (non-IFRS) RMB337.2 million (-38.9%).
quarterly_data.figure: Revenue RMB1,235.5 million (+1,997.6%); gross margin 42.7%; loss RMB377.2 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Biren Technology interim results announcement: Interim Results for the Six Months Ended June 30, 2026 (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Intelligent computing solutions revenue rose to RMB1,168.1 million from RMB58.2 million, which the company attributes to strong demand for its GPGPU solutions and new high-quality clients, leading to at-scale shipment of its Bili series flagship general-purpose GPU products and delivery of large-scale intelligent computing clusters. Software revenue RMB 65,173 thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: Intelligent computing solutions RMB1,168.1 million (vs RMB58.2 million)

quarterly_data.quarter: Biren Technology interim results announcement: Interim Results for the Six Months Ended June 30, 2026 (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customers: the company has completed supplier onboarding and qualification with major internet customers and commenced volume delivery of products. Its customers span leading internet companies, foundation model developers, national-level AI computing platforms, AI data centers, telecom operators and government and enterprise customers; it completed multimodal pre-training and reinforcement learning with several large-model enterprises on thousand-card Bili clusters.

quarterly_data.quarter: Biren Technology interim results announcement: Interim Results for the Six Months Ended June 30, 2026 (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: With partners, Biren launched the 'LightSphere' optical-interconnected, optical circuit switching GPU SuperPods, commercially deployed at multi-thousand-card scale; the company says LightSphere improved end-to-end training throughput on typical MoE models by over 30%. It also jointly built a domestic AI chip computing cluster in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region.
quarterly_data.figure: LightSphere OCS SuperPod: >30% training throughput gain

quarterly_data.quarter: Biren Technology interim results announcement: Interim Results for the Six Months Ended June 30, 2026 (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Roadmap and outlook: the next-generation product (Chiplet-based, FP8/FP4, BLink 2.0 interconnect with scale-up of up to 1,024 GPUs) progressed as planned toward launch and production. At WAIC in July 2026 Biren unveiled a Near-Packaged Optics (NPO) distributed, disaggregated SuperPod supporting up to 1,024 GPUs in one SuperPod domain, in a three-tier line of 16-GPU, 128-GPU and 1,024-GPU SuperPods. Management: existing products continue to scale in deployment, next-generation products are on track for launch and production, and future-generation R&D is accelerating.

quarterly_data.quarter: Biren Technology interim results announcement: Interim Results for the Six Months Ended June 30, 2026 (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Supply: the company says a tightening global supply landscape has made mass-production and delivery capability a key differentiator, and it has secured ample capacity across key industry-chain segments for next-generation mass production and customer deliveries. At June 30, 2026 inventories were RMB1,214.8 million (+28.1% vs end-2025) and prepayments for inventories and services RMB1,534.0 million (+230.0%). Gross trade receivables RMB1,116.9 million (+109.8%), of which RMB260.3 million (23.3%) was collected by the announcement date.
quarterly_data.figure: Inventories RMB1,214.8 million (+28.1%); prepayments RMB1,534.0 million (+230.0%)

Biren Technology.why: Chinese GPGPU designer whose Bili series GPUs and intelligent computing solutions for cloud AI training and inference were RMB1,168.1 million of RMB1,235.5 million H1 2026 revenue; its stock tracks AI training GPU demand.
Biren Technology.evidence: Biren Technology 2026 interim results: revenue from intelligent computing solutions rose to RMB1,168.1 million on at-scale shipment of Bili series flagship general-purpose GPU products and delivery of large-scale intelligent computing clusters; completed supplier onboarding with major internet customers and commenced volume delivery.
